# Georgia Demolition Experts

> Professional demolition services across Georgia — residential, commercial, industrial, and specialized demolition.

## About

Georgia Demolition Experts provides licensed and insured demolition services throughout all 159 Georgia counties. We specialize in safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible demolition for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

## Services

- Residential Demolition (full house demo, garage demo, mobile home removal, barn demo, shed removal, deck removal, fence removal, pool demolition, chimney demolition, driveway removal, foundation demolition, basement demolition, roof demolition, wall demolition, floor removal, interior demolition)
- Post Demolition (site grading, debris removal, lot clearing, concrete removal)
- Core Demolition (building demolition, commercial demolition, industrial demolition, structure demolition, concrete cutting, sawing, coring, floor demolition)
- Specialized Demolition (asbestos abatement, mold remediation, lead paint removal, selective demolition, implosion services, emergency demolition, historic preservation demolition)
- Ancillary Demolition (dumpster rental, porta potty rental, temporary fencing, crane services, equipment rental)

## Coverage

All 159 Georgia counties. Major cities: Atlanta, Augusta, Columbus, Savannah, Athens, Macon, Sandy Springs, Roswell, Albany, Johns Creek, Warner Robins, Alpharetta, Marietta, Valdosta, Smyrna, and 60+ more.

Licensed and insured demolition contractor operating in the State of Georgia. All work performed in compliance with Georgia DNR, EPA, and local municipality regulations.
